translations.web: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
translations.bsb: The fifth, for the fifth month, was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite. There were 24,000 men in his division.
translations.kjv: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
translations.asv: The fifth captain for this fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
